body.arithmetic: a period of N months beginning, or starting, with a day includes that day, so it ends at the end of the day before the same date N months later
body.basis: the primary limit the Act sets, from its words as its publisher gives them for this date ('six months beginning with the effective date of termination'): 6 months beginning with 2026-10-03 end at the end of 2027-04-02. This is the limit for a relevant date on or after 1 October 2026, the relevant date being the effective date of termination. The change from 3 to 6 months is Schedule 12 to the Employment Rights Act 2025, in force on 1 October 2026 by regulation 3 of S.I. 2026/954, and by regulation 4 of S.I. 2026/954 the change does not apply where the relevant date is before 1 October 2026. For a relevant date before 1 October 2026 the limit is 3 months. It does not account for early conciliation through Acas, which must be started before this limit and can extend it, and the tribunal's narrow power to allow a later claim.

body.basis: the primary limit the Act sets, from its words as its publisher gives them for this date ('three months beginning with the effective date of termination'): 3 months beginning with 2026-08-31 would end at the end of the day before the same date 3 months later, but there is no 31 November 2026. The provision does not settle how such a period ends, so the earlier of the two days it could end on is shown: the end of 2026-11-29. This is the limit for a relevant date before 1 October 2026, the relevant date being the effective date of termination. The change from 3 to 6 months is Schedule 12 to the Employment Rights Act 2025, in force on 1 October 2026 by regulation 3 of S.I. 2026/954, and by regulation 4 of S.I. 2026/954 the change does not apply where the relevant date is before 1 October 2026. For a relevant date on or after 1 October 2026 the limit is 6 months. It does not account for early conciliation through Acas, which must be started before this limit and can extend it, and the tribunal's narrow power to allow a later claim.
